correctness.rationale: Exact Fano incidence proof enumerates all 37 independent dominating sets (21 of size four, 14 of size five, 2 of size seven), derives independent-support necessity and monochromatic-four obstruction, supplies all 16 traces for representatives of the two mixed independent quadruple types plus eight traces of a Fano-line triple, and counts facets by exact finite-plane incidence. The attached standalone verify_heawood.py recomputes the concept family from all 16384 vertex subsets, tests all 16384 supports against the proposed characterization, and verifies 336 graph automorphisms and facet-orbit sizes 14,21,56; replay completed successfully. In particular the proof is exhaustive for the specified finite graph, not an inference from sample sizes.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical (3,6)-cage and Fano-plane Levi graph, a natural extremal target for independent sets. For all 37 maximal independent concepts, the new invariant detects a sharp incidence obstruction invisible to their size polynomial or the scalar VC dimension: all independent triples but only 77 of 147 independent quadruples are shattered, and 14 collinear triples are inclusion-maximal despite a dimension-four complex. The complete geometric criterion and three facet orbits are a motivated finite classification, not an arbitrary numeric slice. Its scope and possible priority risks are explicit.
